inlines.v: PR'ANCE, verb intransitive prans. 1. To spring or bound, as a horse in high mettle. Now rule thy prancing steed. 2. To ride with bounding movements; to ride ostentatiously. Th' insulting tyrant prancing o'er the field. 3. To walk or strut about in a showy manner or with warlike parade.
